matrix_name.name: Polyurethane
matrix_name.description: Polyurethane (PU) foam prepared from polyether polyol + TDI with catalyst, organosilicon stabilizer and water (foaming).

fillers.name: Graphene oxide
fillers.description: Graphene oxide loaded with silver nanoparticles (GO@Ag); GO was KH-550 treated to GO-NH2 prior to Ag loading. GO@Ag amount fixed at 8 wt% in composite foam formulations.

fillers.name: Iron(II,III) oxide
fillers.description: Fe3O4@PVA (polyvinyl alcohol magnetic spheres; Fe3O4 modified with oleic acid, then PVAc suspension polymerization and alcoholysis to PVA). Sample label: Fe3O4@PVA/GO@Ag/PU foam-3.
